messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and the detail on your cost structure. We recognise that rising alloy and cold-drawn-bar costs create genuine pressure, while labour carries a smaller weight.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).

Our analysis supports a lower price within a longer agreement, giving you greater continuity for this account while securing predictable purchasing terms for us. We are flexible on payment terms, with an option retaining your proposed term; please choose the package that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.21 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.16 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our relationship with Werdenfels and welcome a substantive discussion grounded in your calculation.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We acknowledge your delivery data and are prepared to adjust our pricing in response.
We welcome the 24-month agreement, but for this duration, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material cost volatility.
Building on your preferred 30-day payment terms, we propose a revised price of €5.60 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
